pairs.name: first poster category
pairs.reason: Frosted (a 8–10px backdrop blur): the blur reaches the poster's tilted top edge and the wall behind it, which each side draws its own way (the app as pictures within EV2a's agreed budget, the mock as live SVG; compared in events-sky). With the blur off on both sides the part is pixel-identical; its box and styles are compared exactly.

pairs.name: first poster tape
pairs.reason: A part of a tilted (1.4° or -1.1°), zoomed poster, its tape tilted again (-3°): with its box and computed styles identical to a thousandth of a pixel, its edges still anti-alias a few pixels apart (at most 2.9% of the part). Up to 3% of its pixels may differ; a changed word or shape moves far more than that.
